sections.heading: Overview
bullets: GW2's newest raid boss (Mount Balrior, added Nov 2024). Defiance bar only opens during specific windows at 75%/25% — miss it and the arena fills with hazards.

sections.heading: Rot the World (breakbar window)
bullets: <mark>Rot the World</mark>: Greer channels spores and briefly opens his defiance bar — break it to stagger him and cut his Empowered stacks by 10-25%. Missing this window is the fight's biggest failure point.

sections.heading: Eruption of Rot
bullets: <mark>Eruption of Rot</mark> puts a stacking indicator on several players — stack on the marked green circle and enough players inside when the timer ends stabilizes it safely. Failing spawns damaging rot walls and buffs Greer, so this isn't optional.

sections.heading: Other hazards
bullets: <mark>Rain of Spores</mark>: a torrent of exploding spores fired along a line moving toward your starting position — move away from where you're standing rather than where the boss is.
<mark>Blob of Blight</mark>: a ranged projectile that leaves a stationary hazard where it lands — move away from your own splat.
<mark>Ripples of Rot</mark>: cascading thorn walls that ripple outward, resolving into <mark>Cage of Decay</mark> — rotating rot cages with boon-corrupting pools. Don't get boxed in.
Spread out for individual mechanics, but be ready to regroup fast for the green-circle stacks.
